name: blueprint/env-audit
description: Toolchain drift as receipts: version commands for node/pnpm/git run through rh_run, one receipt per tool, diff against the previous snapshot
recipe: run version commands (collect, bounded) -> receipt per tool -> diff against the previous snapshot -> summarize the drift
pitfalls: a missing tool is a red receipt, not a guess
the snapshot only means something next to the previous one
